policy: Third-party binaries are never committed. This file is the trust anchor: the fetch stage re-downloads each artifact and compares it against these sha256 digests. Re-pin deliberately, never silently.

proot-static.provenance: Alpine v3.24 community, proot-static 5.4.0-r2, aarch64 static-pie, stripped

match22.why: clang 22.x, the same major as the PVM payload (22.1.8). Required for a like-for-like native column.
match22.known_drift: clang22 comes from edge/main while the base rootfs is v3.24 stable; musl and llvm22 are pulled from edge as a unit. Record the versions the device reports, not the versions assumed here.

stable.why: Fallback when edge/main is unreachable or its musl drifts: clang 18.x, repo-consistent with v3.24.
stable.known_drift: clang 18 is four majors behind the payload. Any proot/bare number produced with it is not comparable to the qemu/pvm columns; the run JSON records the version so the mismatch stays visible.

device_layout.note: App-private or shell-writable locations only. Nothing here needs root.
